caption: The drawing is a detailed pencil illustration on a light beige background, featuring a large central image of a lidded tankard with a curved handle and decorative thumb rest. The tankard is shaded to give a metallic, three-dimensional appearance, and stands on a circular base with two additional ridges near the top and bottom. Surrounding the central tankard drawing are four smaller, line-drawn diagrams: in the upper left corner, a labeled diagram of the handle with measurements (4 1/2 inches high); in the upper right, a top-down view of the thumb piece with measurements (1 3/8 inches wide); in the lower right, a small scaled frontal view of the tankard labeled “5,” with a height measurement of 7 1/2 inches; and in the lower left, a sectional view of the lid, labeled “Separate Lid,” which shows its curvature and a “Fantastical Spiral.” Each of these smaller diagrams is enclosed in a square box and is connected to the central square by straight lines, creating a balanced composition. The overall drawing has a monochrome appearance, rendered in various shades of grey pencil.
title: Pewter Tankard
